message:
feat: Add "How It Was Built" page documenting the entire build process

New page accessible via ?tab=about that covers:
- The origin and motivation for the project
- Phase 1: Data collection (Tardis Wiki, Eyespider, Locations)
- Phase 2: Knowledge graph construction (2,731 nodes, 7,728 edges)
- Phase 3: React application with 4 main tabs
- Phase 4: URL routing for shareable links
- Phase 5: GitHub Pages deployment
- Full timeline of development
- Statistics and tools used

Queried deciduous graph to get original project goal and build history.

author: YOUR_NAME_HERE
message:
feat: Add URL query param routing for all pages

- Add useUrlState and useUrlBooleanState hooks for URL state sync
- App.tsx: ?tab=chronology|timeline|locations|knowledge
- Chronology: ?q=search&doctor=Fourth&sort=title&missing=1&episode=123
- Knowledge Graph: ?gq=search&cat=enemies&node=42&view=browse
- Timeline: ?era=classic|modern&doc=4
- Locations: ?city=Cardiff&type=studio&loc=locationName

Also fixes synopsis truncation - now shows full episode synopsis.

All state is now shareable via URL - users can share exact view states.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The site now has:

- Knowledge Graph tab with embedded deciduous viewer (iframe)
